name: requantize
title: Requantize a tape take
summary: shift + blue knob press (synth playmode) starts a take (notes + TE's record range logged); shift + blue press again opens SYNTH ROLL on the tape screen (DRUM ROLL's look): the take as a piano roll with four pages NOTE / FINE / QUANT / TAKE, a knob turn edits the value under it, green press = next page, white press = preview, orange press = the page's action (quantize the note(s), all notes AUTO, commit). Default mode CLEAN: every note starts on its nearest grid point and lasts whole grid steps (never before the take); SNAP / QUEUE / STRICT stay selectable. Commit onto the take's own track lifts the original clip (to TE's clipboard, drop restores it) and records the roll over exactly the original range; onto another track it records there and mutes the original. AUTO notes follow grid + mode, edited notes keep theirs.
controls: shift + blue knob press (not in drum playmode and not on the sequencer screen: there it is TE's / DRUM ROLL's / NOTE ROLL's): start a take / end it (opens SYNTH ROLL) / exit / abort a running preview or commit

SYNTH ROLL (tape screen), NOTE ROLL's navigation: the cursor = a grid step + a pitch row; knob turn = the value under it, green press = next page, blue press = a note at the cursor on / off (new notes too), white press = preview (again = stop), orange press = the page's action

P1 NOTE: STEP / PITCH / VEL / LENGTH (grid steps), orange press = quantize the note or selection; P2 TIME: NOTE (jump) / MOVE (grid steps) / NUDGE (5 ms) / LEN MS, orange press = quantize; P3 QUANT: GRID / MODE (CLEAN SNAP QUEUE STRICT) / ZOOM, orange press = every note back to AUTO; P4 TAKE: TRACK (own track = replace), orange press = commit
shift: blue turn = the cursor's pitch row; green press = select all / none, white press = select the cursor note, orange press = as played <-> AUTO
SYNTH ROLL: shift + BACK = undo, shift + FORWARD = redo (24 states of the take)
status_note: 4.3: undo / redo (shift + BACK / FORWARD); 4.2: drawing: added notes deleted go for good, deleted = a thin line, one cursor frame size, rows >= 4 px; 4.1: NOTE ROLL's navigation (grid-step + pitch-row cursor, blue press = note on / off, new notes, VEL); 4.0: SYNTH ROLL: DRUM ROLL's design and page handling, default mode CLEAN (start + length on the grid); shift + blue is TE's in drum playmode and on the sequencer screen (DRUM / NOTE ROLL); fix: a shift + blue release with shift still held no longer swallows the next blue release; 3.2: grids longest first, 1/4T added (flashed); 3.1 (device-tested, user: very nice): panel and piano roll are one screen (green press = knobs on notes / take settings); 3.0: piano roll (requantize-roll.md); v2.4: STRICT mode (notes/chords packed one grid step apart); v2.3: 1/32T grid; v2.2: commit record pass starts 0.25 s before the take (TE's record fade-in hits silence, not the first notes); v2.1: preview selects an unmuted track; v2.0: replace = lift + record pass (TE records overdub); v1.1 transport device-tested; 2.5: keyboard log runs as a never-consuming filter after CHORD+ (logs chord notes)
